019package org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog;
020
021import static java.util.Arrays.asList;
022import static org.apiguardian.api.API.Status.STABLE;
023import static org.tquadrat.foundation.lang.Objects.requireNonNullArgument;
024import static org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.PerfLogUtils.createPerformanceSectionName;
025
026import java.util.Optional;
027
028import org.apiguardian.api.API;
029import org.tquadrat.foundation.annotation.ClassVersion;
030import org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.internal.PerfLogManagerImpl;
031
032/**
033 *  <p>{@summary This interface describes the MBean for the Foundation
034 *  Performance Logging and Monitoring.}</p>
035 *
036 *  @extauthor Thomas Thrien - thomas.thrien@tquadrat.org
037 *  @version $Id: PerfLogManager.java 1211 2026-05-01 15:24:10Z tquadrat $
038 *  @since 0.25.0
039 *
040 *  @UMLGraph.link
041 */
042@ClassVersion( sourceVersion = "$Id: PerfLogManager.java 1211 2026-05-01 15:24:10Z tquadrat $" )
043@API( status = STABLE, since = "0.25.0" )
044public sealed interface PerfLogManager extends AutoCloseable
045    permits PerfLogManagerImpl
046{
047        /*---------*\
048    ====** Methods **==========================================================
049        \*---------*/
050    /**
051     *  {@inheritDoc}
052     *  <p>After {@code close()} is called, calls to other methods of this
053     *  instance may result in an
054     *  {@link IllegalStateException}
055     *  to be thrown.</p>
056     */
057    @Override
058    public void close();
059
060    /**
061     *  <p>{@summary Creates a performance tracker for the
062     *  {@link PerformanceSection}
063     *  with the given name.}</p>
064     *  <p>The return value will be empty if the performance section is
065     *  currently ignored.</p>
066     *
067     *  @param  name    The name of the performance section.
068     *  @return An instance of
069     *      {@link Optional}
070     *      that holds the new tracker.
071     *  @throws IllegalStateException
072     *      {@link #close()}
073     *      was already called on this instance.
074     */
075    public default Optional<PerformanceTracker> createPerformanceTracker( final String name ) throws IllegalStateException
076    {
077        final var retValue = createPerformanceTracker( createPerformanceSectionName( name ) );
078
079        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
080        return retValue;
081    }   //  createPerformanceTracker()
082
083    /**
084     *  <p>{@summary Creates a performance tracker for the
085     *  {@link PerformanceSection}
086     *  with the given name.}</p>
087     *  <p>The return value will be empty if the performance section is
088     *  currently ignored.</p>
089     *
090     *  @param  name    The name of the performance section.
091     *  @return An instance of
092     *      {@link Optional}
093     *      that holds the new tracker.
094     *  @throws IllegalStateException
095     *      {@link #close()}
096     *      was already called on this instance.
097     */
098    public Optional<PerformanceTracker> createPerformanceTracker( final PerformanceSectionName name ) throws IllegalStateException;
099
100    /**
101     *  <p>{@summary Returns the performance section specified by the given
102     *  name.}</p>
103     *  <p>Delegates to
104     *  {@link PerfLogMBean#getPerformanceSection(PerformanceSectionName)}</p>
105     *
106     *  @param  name    The name of the performance section.
107     *  @return An instance of
108     *      {@link Optional}
109     *      that holds the retrieved performance section.
110     *  @throws IllegalStateException
111     *      {@link #close()}
112     *      was already called on this instance.
113     */
114    public Optional<PerformanceSection> getPerformanceSection( final PerformanceSectionName name ) throws IllegalStateException;
115
116    /**
117     *  Loads the
118     *  {@link PerformanceSection}
119     *  definitions.
120     *
121     *  @param  definitions The definitions for the performance sections.
122     *  @throws IllegalStateException
123     *      {@link #close()}
124     *      was already called on this instance.
125     */
126    public default void loadPerformanceSectionDefinitions( final PerformanceSection... definitions ) throws IllegalStateException
127    {
128        loadPerformanceSectionDefinitions( asList( requireNonNullArgument( definitions, "definitions" ) ) );
129    }   //  loadPerformanceSectionDefinitions()
130
131    /**
132     *  Loads the
133     *  {@link PerformanceSection}
134     *  definitions.
135     *
136     *  @param  definitions The definitions for the performance sections.
137     *  @throws IllegalStateException
138     *      {@link #close()}
139     *      was already called on this instance.
140     */
141    public void loadPerformanceSectionDefinitions( final Iterable<PerformanceSection> definitions ) throws IllegalStateException;
142}
143//  interface PerfLogManager
144
145/*
146 *  End of File
147 */
